parameters.query:
INSERT INTO contacts (whatsapp_id, phone, display_name, last_contact_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, NULLIF($3, ''), NOW())
ON CONFLICT (whatsapp_id) DO UPDATE SET
  phone = EXCLUDED.phone,
  display_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.display_name, contacts.display_name),
  last_contact_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, state;

WITH contact_row AS (
  SELECT id, state FROM contacts WHERE whatsapp_id = $2
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO message_events (external_id, contact_id, direction, message_type, content_summary, media_reference, event_at)
  SELECT $1, id, 'incoming', $3, NULLIF($4, ''), NULLIF($5, ''), $6::timestamptz FROM contact_row
  ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
), config AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'evolution_instance'), 'kit-matematica') AS "evolutionInstance",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'product_price'), '9.90') AS "productPrice",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'pix_key'), '') AS "pixKey",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'pix_key_type'), 'telefone') AS "pixKeyType",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'pix_receiver_name'), '') AS "pixReceiverName",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'materials_drive_url'), '') AS "materialsDriveUrl",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'followup_minutes'), '15,60,91') AS "followupMinutes",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'payment_notify_phone'), '') AS "paymentNotifyPhone",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'mercado_pago_access_token'), '') AS "mercadoPagoAccessToken",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'mercado_pago_min_amount'), '10.00') AS "mercadoPagoMinAmount",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'mercado_pago_amounts'), '10.00,14.90,19.90,29.90,49.90') AS "mercadoPagoAmounts",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'evolution_go_base_url'), 'http://host.docker.internal:4000') AS "evolutionGoBaseUrl",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'evolution_go_api_key'), 'pix-go-test') AS "evolutionGoApiKey",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'meta_whatsapp_phone_number_id'), '') AS "metaWhatsAppPhoneNumberId",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'meta_whatsapp_access_token'), '') AS "metaWhatsAppAccessToken",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'meta_whatsapp_api_version'), 'v21.0') AS "metaWhatsAppApiVersion"
  FROM app_config
)
SELECT c.id AS "contactId", c.state, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS inserted,
       $2::text AS "whatsappId", $7::text AS phone, $8::text AS intent,
       $3::text AS "messageType", $4::text AS text, $5::text AS "mediaReference",
       config."evolutionInstance", config."productPrice", config."pixKey", config."pixKeyType",
       config."pixReceiverName", config."materialsDriveUrl", config."followupMinutes", config."paymentNotifyPhone",
       config."mercadoPagoAccessToken", config."mercadoPagoMinAmount", config."mercadoPagoAmounts",
       config."evolutionGoBaseUrl", config."evolutionGoApiKey",
       config."metaWhatsAppPhoneNumberId", config."metaWhatsAppAccessToken", config."metaWhatsAppApiVersion"
FROM contact_row c CROSS JOIN config;

WITH sale AS (
  INSERT INTO sales (contact_id, expected_amount) VALUES ($1, $2::numeric)
  ON CONFLICT (contact_id) WHERE status = 'pending' DO UPDATE SET expected_amount = EXCLUDED.expected_amount
  RETURNING id, contact_id, expected_amount
), schedule AS (
  SELECT string_to_array($3, ',')::int[] AS mins
), created AS (
  INSERT INTO followups (contact_id, sale_id, sequence_number, scheduled_at)
  SELECT sale.contact_id, sale.id, ordinality::smallint, NOW() + (minute_value || ' minutes')::interval
  FROM sale, schedule, unnest(schedule.mins) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(minute_value, ordinality)
  ON CONFLICT (contact_id, sequence_number) DO NOTHING
), contact_update AS (
  UPDATE contacts SET state = 'awaiting_payment', next_followup_at = NOW() + (split_part($3, ',', 1) || ' minutes')::interval
  WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id
), config AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'mercado_pago_access_token'), '') AS "mercadoPagoAccessToken",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'mercado_pago_min_amount'), '10.00') AS "mercadoPagoMinAmount",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'mercado_pago_amounts'), '10.00,14.90,19.90,29.90,49.90') AS "mercadoPagoAmounts"
  FROM app_config
)
SELECT sale.id AS "saleId", sale.contact_id AS "contactId", sale.expected_amount AS "expectedAmount",
       config."mercadoPagoAccessToken", config."mercadoPagoMinAmount", config."mercadoPagoAmounts"
FROM sale CROSS JOIN config;

parameters.query:
WITH config AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'mercado_pago_access_token'), '') AS "mercadoPagoAccessToken",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'mercado_pago_min_amount'), '10.00')::numeric AS "mercadoPagoMinAmount",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'materials_drive_url'), '') AS "materialsDriveUrl",
    COALESCE(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE key = 'payment_notify_phone'), '') AS "paymentNotifyPhone"
  FROM app_config
), sale AS (
  SELECT * FROM sales WHERE contact_id = $1 AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT sale.id AS "saleId", sale.contact_id AS "contactId",
       COALESCE(NULLIF(sale.mercado_pago_external_reference, ''), 'missing:' || sale.id::text) AS "mercadoPagoExternalReference",
       sale.mercado_pago_payment_id AS "mercadoPagoPaymentId",
       c.phone, c.display_name AS "displayName", config."mercadoPagoAccessToken", config."mercadoPagoMinAmount", config."materialsDriveUrl", config."paymentNotifyPhone"
FROM sale JOIN contacts c ON c.id = sale.contact_id CROSS JOIN config;

WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT $1::bigint AS sale_id,
         $2::text AS payment_id,
         $3::text AS mp_status,
         $4::text AS status_detail,
         $5::numeric AS paid_amount,
         $6::numeric AS min_amount,
         NULLIF($7::text, '') AS extra_url,
         NULLIF($8::text, '') AS notify_phone,
         $9::jsonb AS raw_payment
), locked AS (
  SELECT s.* FROM sales s JOIN incoming i ON i.sale_id = s.id FOR UPDATE
), updated_sale AS (
  UPDATE sales s
  SET mercado_pago_status = i.mp_status,
      mercado_pago_status_detail = i.status_detail,
      confirmed_amount = CASE WHEN i.mp_status = 'approved' AND i.paid_amount >= i.min_amount THEN i.paid_amount ELSE s.confirmed_amount END,
      status = CASE WHEN i.mp_status = 'approved' AND i.paid_amount >= i.min_amount THEN 'paid' ELSE s.status END,
      confirmed_by = CASE WHEN i.mp_status = 'approved' AND i.paid_amount >= i.min_amount THEN 'mercado_pago' ELSE s.confirmed_by END,
      confirmed_at = CASE WHEN i.mp_status = 'approved' AND i.paid_amount >= i.min_amount THEN COALESCE(s.confirmed_at, NOW()) ELSE s.confirmed_at END
  FROM incoming i
  WHERE s.id = i.sale_id
  RETURNING s.id, s.contact_id, s.status, (i.mp_status = 'approved' AND i.paid_amount >= i.min_amount) AS approved, i.paid_amount, i.extra_url, i.notify_phone, i.raw_payment
), updated_contact AS (
  UPDATE contacts c SET state = 'paid', next_followup_at = NULL
  FROM updated_sale u WHERE c.id = u.contact_id AND u.approved
  RETURNING c.id
), cancelled_followups AS (
  UPDATE followups f SET status = 'cancelled'
  FROM updated_sale u WHERE f.sale_id = u.id AND u.approved AND f.status IN ('pending', 'processing')
  RETURNING f.id
), audit AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (actor, action, entity_type, entity_id, details)
  SELECT 'mercado_pago', 'payment_confirmed', 'sale', u.id, jsonb_build_object('amount', u.paid_amount, 'payment', u.raw_payment)
  FROM updated_sale u WHERE u.approved
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
), queued AS (
  INSERT INTO outbox (contact_id, message_type, payload, dedupe_key)
  SELECT u.contact_id, 'payment_release', jsonb_build_object('saleId', u.id, 'amount', u.paid_amount, 'extraUrl', COALESCE(u.extra_url, '')), 'mp-release:' || u.id
  FROM updated_sale u WHERE u.approved
  ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
), admin_notice AS (
  INSERT INTO outbox (contact_id, message_type, payload, dedupe_key)
  SELECT u.contact_id, 'payment_admin_notify', jsonb_build_object('toPhone', u.notify_phone, 'saleId', u.id, 'amount', u.paid_amount, 'customer', COALESCE(c.display_name, 'Cliente'), 'customerPhone', c.phone), 'mp-admin:' || u.id
  FROM updated_sale u JOIN contacts c ON c.id = u.contact_id
  WHERE u.approved AND u.notify_phone IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT id AS "saleId", status, approved FROM updated_sale;

parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT $1::bigint AS sale_id,
         $2::text AS typed_name,
         $3::boolean AS matched,
         $4::numeric AS confidence,
         NULLIF($5::text, '') AS payment_id,
         $6::numeric AS paid_amount,
         NULLIF($7::text, '') AS matched_name,
         $8::text AS mp_status,
         $9::text AS status_detail,
         NULLIF($10::text, '') AS notify_phone,
         $11::jsonb AS raw_payment
), updated_sale AS (
  UPDATE sales s
  SET mercado_pago_payment_id = COALESCE(i.payment_id, s.mercado_pago_payment_id),
      mercado_pago_status = i.mp_status,
      mercado_pago_status_detail = i.status_detail,
      confirmed_amount = CASE WHEN i.matched THEN i.paid_amount ELSE s.confirmed_amount END
  FROM incoming i
  WHERE s.id = i.sale_id
  RETURNING s.id, s.contact_id, s.status, i.typed_name, i.matched, i.confidence, i.payment_id, i.paid_amount, i.matched_name, i.notify_phone, i.raw_payment, i.status_detail
), audit AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (actor, action, entity_type, entity_id, details)
  SELECT 'mercado_pago', CASE WHEN u.matched THEN 'payment_possible_name_match' ELSE 'payment_name_not_found' END,
         'sale', u.id,
         jsonb_build_object('typedName', u.typed_name, 'matched', u.matched, 'confidence', u.confidence, 'paymentId', u.payment_id, 'amount', u.paid_amount, 'matchedName', u.matched_name, 'statusDetail', u.status_detail, 'matchMode', $12::text, 'payment', u.raw_payment)
  FROM updated_sale u
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT u.id AS "saleId", u.contact_id AS "contactId", u.status, u.typed_name AS "typedPayerName", u.matched,
       u.confidence, u.payment_id AS "matchedPaymentId", u.paid_amount AS "matchedAmount", u.matched_name AS "matchedName",
       u.notify_phone AS "paymentNotifyPhone", c.phone, c.display_name AS "displayName"
FROM updated_sale u JOIN contacts c ON c.id = u.contact_id;
